children: According to CNBC, Bank of America said investors should buy weakness in several stocks it views as intriguing opportunities, including Nvidia, Thor Industries, Lyntris, Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage and Dutch Bros. The bank initiated coverage of Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage with a buy rating and a $35 price target, saying the organic grocer offers premium quality at a lower price point and has catalysts including margin expansion, product affordability and rapid expansion. Analyst Vicky Liu said the market underestimates NGVC's growth runway and margin potential, and the stock is up more than 5% over the past three months and almost 19% in 2026. Bank of America also reiterated a buy view on Dutch Bros, with analyst Sara Senatore saying concerns about near-term same-store sales and longer-term competition have weighed too heavily on the valuation. She said the coffee category remains one of the fastest-growing segments in restaurants and cited rising espresso-based beverage consumption, which she said was 43% in 2025 versus 37% in 2020. For Lyntris, analyst Ronald Epstein said the defense connectivity systems company is best positioned for rising demand and noted Bank of America was a joint book-running manager for its Aug. 18 IPO. He said the firm sees market tailwinds across space, maritime and air defense, while Nvidia was assigned a $350 price objective based on its position in AI compute and networking markets.

title: Bank of America Names Nvidia, Thor Industries, Lyntris, Natural Grocers and Dutch Bros as Buy Ideas
